LED Over Heat (#01) 🔥.problem: The temperature of the LED light source is too high.
repairs: Check whether the air outlet of the light source is shielded by any object. If yes, remove the object.

LED Over Life Time (#02) ⌛.problem: The LED has reached the end of its service life.
repairs: Contact Mindray Customer Service Department for replacement

LED Over Heat >105°C (#03) 🌡️.problem: The temperature of the LED light source exceeds 105°C.
repairs: Check whether the light source is in an environment out of the temperature requirement

LD Over Heat (#04) 🔥.problem: The temperature of the LD light source is too high.
causes: Blocked ventilation or poor heat dissipation
repairs: Check whether the air outlet of the LD light source is shielded by any object. If yes, remove the object

LD Over Heat > Limit (#05) 🌡️.problem: The temperature of the LD light source exceeds the operating temperature.
repairs: Check whether the light source is in an environment out of the temperature requirement

LED Error (#06) ⚠️.problem: The LED temperature sensor is not connected.
repairs: Contact Mindray Customer Service Department

Fan Error (#08) 🌬️.problem: Fans are not connected or are clogged.
repairs: Ensure that the ventilation outlets of fans have no object that could stop the fans from rotating

Device Does Not Power On 🔌.problem: The system does not turn on when pressing the power button.
repairs: Check power input connection
Verify 24V DC output from power supply
Replace fuse or power board as needed

Image Does Not Appear on Monitor 🖥️.problem: The connected monitor does not display image from the system.
repairs: Use maintenance menu to check and adjust resolution
Replace video cable
Test and replace image board if no signal is present

Device Restarts During Use 🔁.problem: The unit reboots or powers off unexpectedly.
repairs: Ensure device is placed in ventilated space
Check fan operation and clean filters
Test AC power stability

Touch Panel Unresponsive 📱.problem: The touchscreen does not react to input.
repairs: Reconnect J11 connector
Replace touch controller or front panel

Fan Makes Unusual Noise 🌬️.problem: There is abnormal noise from internal fan.
repairs: Clean fan blades and vents
Replace fan if noise persists
